# platform.AdminUsage

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Model usage and cost for staff, by UTC day and by model, of every organization or of one.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `platform.AdminUsage` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `platform.usage.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `byDay` | yes | `none` | One row per day of the range, in order; days without calls are zero. |  |
| `byModel` | yes | `none` | One row per provider and model, highest cost first. |  |
| `from` | yes | `none` | First UTC day of the range. |  |
| `generatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the numbers were computed (UTC). |  |
| `organizationId` | yes | `none` | Organization the numbers are of; null = every live organization. |  |
| `organizations` | yes | `none` | Organizations whose ledger was read. |  |
| `to` | yes | `none` | Last UTC day of the range, included. |  |
| `totals` | yes | `none` | Totals of the range. |  |
| `truncated` | yes | `none` | True when there are more organizations than one answer reads; the totals then cover only the ones read. |  |

_None._
